claim: AWS Snowball Edge is an edge computing and data transfer device that has on-board storage and compute power.
question: What is AWS Snowball Edge?

values.display: edge computing and data transfer device

qualifiers.condition: FAQ wording; the service is closed to new customers

evidence.quote: AWS Snowball Edge is an edge computing and data transfer device provided by the AWS Snowball service. It has on-board storage and compute power that provides select AWS services for use in edge locations.

claim: Snowball Edge comes in two options, Storage Optimized and Compute Optimized, for local data processing and collection in disconnected environments such as ships, windmills and remote factories.
question: What options does Snowball Edge come in?

evidence.quote: Snowball Edge comes in two options, Storage Optimized and Compute Optimized, to support local data processing and collection in disconnected environments such as ships, windmills, and remote factories.

claim: Snowball Edge Storage Optimized is the choice for securely and quickly transferring dozens of terabytes to petabytes of data to AWS; Compute Optimized is recommended for use cases that need powerful compute and high-speed storage to process data before transferring it into AWS.
question: What is the difference between the AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized and AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized options?

values.display: dozens of terabytes to petabytes of data

evidence.quote: AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized is the optimal choice if you need to securely and quickly transfer dozens of terabytes to petabytes of data to AWS. We recommend using Snowball Edge Compute Optimized for use cases that require access to powerful compute and high-speed storage for data processing before transferring it into AWS.

claim: Consider Snowball Edge to run computing in rugged, austere, mobile or disconnected environments, and for large-scale data transfers and migrations when bandwidth is not available for a high-speed online transfer service such as AWS DataSync.
question: Who should use AWS Snowball Edge?

values.display: when bandwidth is not available for use of a high-speed online transfer service

qualifiers.condition: status: only available to existing customers since November 7, 2025

evidence.quote: Consider Snowball Edge if you need to run computing in rugged, austere, mobile, or disconnected (or intermittently connected) environments. Also consider it for large-scale data transfers and migrations when bandwidth is not available for use of a high-speed online transfer service, such as AWS DataSync.

claim: Snowball Edge cannot be used to migrate data from one AWS Region to another; it moves data into and out of a designated Region, and S3 Cross-Region Replication is the recommended alternative for transfer between Regions.
question: Can I use AWS Snowball Edge to migrate data from one AWS Region to another AWS Region?

evidence.quote: No. Snowball Edge is intended to serve as a data transport solution for moving high volumes of data into and out of a designated AWS Region. For use cases that require data transfer between AWS Regions, we recommend using S3 Cross-Region Replication as an alternative.

claim: You can transfer up to approximately 210 TB with a single Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device, and larger data sets with multiple devices, in parallel or sequentially.
question: How much data can I transfer using AWS Snowball Edge?

qualifiers.scope: per Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device
qualifiers.condition: approximate; use several devices for larger datasets

evidence.quote: You can transfer up to approximately 210 TB with a single Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device and can transfer even larger data sets with multiple devices, either in parallel, or sequentially.

claim: Snowball Edge transfer speed depends on local network speed, file size and how fast data can be read from your local servers, and the total time includes loading and unloading the device and shipping it to and from your location.
question: How long does it take to transfer my data?

values.display: local network speed, file size, and the speed at which data can be read

qualifiers.condition: the FAQ gives no fixed number of days

evidence.quote: Data transfer speed is affected by a number of factors including local network speed, file size, and the speed at which data can be read from your local servers. The total time to transfer 210 TB data includes the time taken to load and unload data from the device, the time involved in shipping the devices to and from your location.

claim: Provisioning and preparing a Snowball device after you place the job order may take up to 4 weeks, which is not included in the transfer timeline and should be part of the project plan.
question: How much time does it take to prepare and provision a Snowball device before it is shipped?

qualifiers.condition: from the time of order placement

evidence.quote: Once you place a job order for a Snowball device, we will provision, prepare, and ship the device. This provisioning process may take up to 4 weeks from the time of order placement. This timeline should be factored into your project plan to ensure a seamless transition.

claim: Jobs using a Snowball Edge device must be completed within 360 days of being prepared; after 360 days the device becomes locked, can no longer be accessed and must be returned, unless you contact AWS Support to keep it longer.
question: How long can I have a AWS Snowball Edge for a specific job?

qualifiers.condition: contact AWS Support to keep a device longer than 360 days

evidence.quote: For security purposes, jobs using an AWS Snowball Edge device must be completed within 360 days of being prepared. If you need to keep one or more devices for longer than 360 days, contact AWS Support. Otherwise, after 360 days, the device becomes locked, can no longer be accessed, and must be returned.

claim: By default Snowball Edge uses two-day shipping by UPS, and you can choose expedited shipping if your jobs are time-sensitive.
question: What is the AWS Snowball Edge default shipping option? Can I choose expedited shipping?

evidence.quote: As a default, Snowball Edge uses two-day shipping by UPS. You can choose expedited shipping if your jobs are time-sensitive.

claim: A Snowball Edge device must be requested and used within the same AWS Region as your S3 bucket and cannot be requested in one Region and returned to another; devices for EU imports or exports may be used with any of the other EU countries.
question: Can an AWS Snowball Edge be shipped to an alternate AWS Region?

values.display: within the same AWS Region where your S3 bucket is located

qualifiers.condition: EU devices may be used with any other EU country

evidence.quote: No. AWS Snowball Edge devices are designed to be requested and used within the same AWS Region where your S3 bucket is located. The device may not be requested from one Region and returned to another. Snowball Edge devices used for imports or exports from an AWS Region in the EU may be used with any of the other EU countries.

claim: Snowball Edge encrypts all data with 256-bit encryption; you manage the keys with AWS KMS, the keys are never stored on the device, and all memory is erased when it is disconnected and returned to AWS.
question: Does AWS Snowball Edge encrypt my data?

evidence.quote: AWS Snowball Edge encrypts all data with 256-bit encryption. You manage your encryption keys by using the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Your keys are never stored on the device and all memory is erased when it is disconnected and returned to AWS.

claim: After a Snowball Edge is connected and activated, you can transfer data from local sources to it through the S3-compatible endpoint or the NFS file interface, both available on the device, or with the Snowball client.
question: How do I transfer my data to the AWS Snowball Edge?

values.display: S3-compatible endpoint or the NFS file interface

evidence.quote: After you have connected and activated the Snowball Edge, you can transfer data from local sources to the device through the S3-compatible endpoint or the NFS file interface, both available on the device. You can also use the Snowball client to copy data.

claim: You cannot stop the data on a returned Snowball device from being deleted after an import: AWS securely erases the device according to NIST 800-88 standards and the same device cannot be returned to you.
question: Is it possible to stop data from being deleted on a returned AWS Snowball device after the data import is completed?

qualifiers.condition: after the data import is completed

evidence.quote: No. AWS uses an automated workflow process to securely delete the data ingest and clean the returned device with a complete erasure of the Snowball device according to NIST 800-88 standards. Additionally, it is not possible to return the same device back to you after the data import is complete.

claim: AWS typically starts exporting your data within 24 hours of receiving the export request, and exporting data can take as long as a week.
question: How quickly can I access my exported data?

qualifiers.condition: typical start; export can take up to a week

evidence.quote: We typically start exporting your data within 24 hours of receiving your request, and exporting data can take as long as a week.

claim: A Snowball export job from S3 cannot access objects in the S3 Glacier or S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage classes; you must first restore them for a minimum of 10 days or until the export job completes.
question: I created an export job of my Amazon S3 bucket and it contains keys which are in an Amazon S3 Glacier storage class. Will the keys be exported?

qualifiers.scope: AWS Snowball Edge export jobs from S3
qualifiers.condition: objects in S3 Glacier or S3 Glacier Deep Archive

evidence.quote: The Snowball export job from Amazon S3 workflow does not have access to the objects stored in the Amazon S3 Glacier or Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage classes. You must first restore these objects from the Glacier or Glacier Deep archive for a minimum of 10 days or until the Snowball export job completes to ensure that these restored objects are successfully copied to the Snowball device.
